subject: Commercial concession request: pilot -> enterprise (Nova Therapeutics)
messages:
From: Evan Ramos <evan.ramos@novatherapeutics.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.kapur@novatherapeutics.com
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot -> enterprise pricing ask (Nova Therapeutics)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo this week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the caching suggestions. We want to move the small oncology pilot into a company-wide deployment over the next 12 months, but we need to align commercials before we commit.

High-level ask: a 24-month committed package for 200M tokens/month starting Q1, with a blended unit price ~40% below your listed enterprise rates, plus inclusion of our private VPC deployment license without the standard one-time infra fee. This package is contingent on an uptime SLA and early access to your Optimize recommendations.

I attached a short deal summary with projected spend. Can you share the internal approval path for this kind of concession? We have procurement review next Wednesday.

Best,
Evan Ramos
Director, Platform Engineering
Nova Therapeutics
Attachment: NTX_MAR-Deal_Summary.xlsx (spreadsheet summary, 1 sheet)
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot -> enterprise pricing ask (Nova Therapeutics)

Folks — forwarding the ask from Nova. Key points: 24 months, 200M tokens/mo baseline, requesting ~40% off list and waiver of VPC onboarding fee. Procurement wants decision by next Wednesday (11/4).

Why I think it merits escalation:
- ARR and expansion: If they land, we’re looking at ~$6.5M ARR in year 1 (conservative model), plus upsell corridors for imaging/embedding usage.
- Strategic: High-profile oncology customer, likely referenceable; they're also piloting a clinical workflow that could open other accounts in the space.
- Risk: The requested discount materially compresses unit economics at our standard batch/cache assumptions; infra waiver is roughly a $60k one-time offset.

Suggested concession structure (internal proposal):
1) Conditional 30% committed discount off enterprise list for first 12 months, stepping to 20% in year two, tied to 24-month min term and minimum monthly consumption of 150M tokens (true-up clauses).
2) Waive VPC onboarding fee if they sign within two weeks and provide a referral case study after launch.
3) SLA and Optimize access granted as part of Dedicated package; premium support add-on at standard rates.

Requesting: VP/CFO sign-off on the stepped concession and the VPC waiver. Markus/Jordan — can you confirm revenue impact and whether this aligns with precedent? Marissa — need your OK for the one-time infra cost waiver and the stepped discount.

Thanks,
Tessa
Account Exec — Strategic Health
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot -> enterprise pricing ask (Nova Therapeutics)

Short answer: I can support the stepped concession with the conditions below. Quick notes from a bookings / precedent lens:

- 30% first-year / 20% second-year stepped is within the range we authorized for high-strategic pilots, provided legal and finance sign tight true-up and termination for non-performance.
- Require a minimum committed monthly floor of 150M tokens and a 60-day ramp plan in the SOW. If actual usage falls short we true-up to the committed spend or apply a clawback.
- Approve waiving the VPC onboarding fee only if we secure an enterprise case study and a reference permission clause in the contract.

Jordan — please add any implementation/resourcing implications for Dedicated capacity (GPU footprint) and confirm whether burst capacity will be included in the first 6 months.

Markus
VP Sales
From: jordan.blake@redwood.ai <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot -> enterprise pricing ask (Nova Therapeutics)

Agree with Markus. Implementation notes:
- We can provision the Dedicated pool for the committed baseline. For a 150–200M token baseline expect sustained small GPU fleet (A100-equivalent) plus modest burst. Rough estimate of incremental monthly infra cost: $45k–65k depending on KV cache hit rates.
- Recommend we include a 3-month performance review checkpoint (latency / cost per token / cache hit) with options to tune quantization and batching.
- We should not promise unlimited burst; cap burst at 1.5x baseline for first 90 days.

If Marissa signs off on the one-time waiver we can include the SOW language and a 30-day notice clause for decreased capacity needs.

-Jordan
Director, Customer Solutions
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot -> enterprise pricing ask (Nova Therapeutics)

Thanks team — I reviewed the numbers and precedent. I will sign off on the stepped concession (30% / 20%) and the VPC onboarding fee waiver on the following conditions:

1) Legal to include true-up and clawback language tied to minimum monthly consumption (150M tokens floor) and an audit right for usage reporting.
2) Exec reference / case study commitment in the master services agreement and a product testimonial from their CTO within 6 months of go-live.
3) Add a revenue protection clause: if average realized unit economics are worse than our modeled threshold after the 3-month performance review, account to enter a renegotiation window and we reserve rights to adjust pricing going forward.

Once Legal drafts the SOW amendment and we have the case study clause, I authorize Tessa to finalize commercials and route to DocuSign. Jord, please include the infra estimate in the SOW appendix.

Marissa Cole
SVP, Finance (acting CFO)
Redwood Inference
Attachment references: redwood-standard-terms-v1.2.pdf
